name: Mousehop KVM
author: maxt
description: Shows whether the mousehop software-KVM client is armed, and toggles it on click. ON = pushing the pointer into the peer's edge captures the pointer and keyboard and hands them to the other machine; OFF = mousehop never takes an InputCapture session, so the pointer and every key stay local. Same action as SUPER+SHIFT+K (tlit-mousehop-toggle toggle).

barWidget.description: mousehop on/off — is the pointer/keyboard armed to cross to the peer machine? Click to toggle (SUPER+SHIFT+K)
